# 26 author-written adversarial inputs found zero holes; a fresh agent found nine

A gate's author wrote 26 breaking inputs for it. All 26 were caught. Zero holes.

An agent that had never seen the parser then found NINE, including a four-slice ledger
claiming `proof: it works` / `tier: eyeballed` / `commit: yes` that parsed to zero slices
and zero errors, and got "all checks passed".

All 26 of the author's attacked one direction: a slice the parser SEES holding bad data.
All 9 attacked the other: a slice the parser never sees.
